Date: 2026-03-30 10:00 AM UTC

Attendees: Maya Patel, Owen Park, Marcus Lee, Priya Nair, Jun Kim, Lena Rodriguez, Sophie Tran, Ethan Shaw, Zara Khan + All

[00:00] Maya Patel: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, uh we're gonna kick off, lots to cover so we'll keep it tight. Good morning, good afternoon wherever you are.
[00:12] Owen Park: morning all, quick thanks to infra team for getting through the spike last week, I know it was rough.
[00:18] Marcus Lee: yep, big shout out to infra and to SEs who ran the customer runbooks. Some learnings to share in infra section.
[00:29] Priya Nair: quick note on product - Q2 is gonna focus on two big bets: predictability (Dedicated & Private scaling) and cost ops, so batching/quantization recommendations are top of list.
[00:42] Jun Kim: also ramping on new docs and example apps for devrel, we'll push samples for private deploy next week.
[00:49] Lena Rodriguez: nice, customers have been asking for clearer migration path from hosted to dedicated. We're getting consistent asks on throughput and SLOs.
[00:58] Ethan Shaw: sales update - net new ARR up 22% q/q, expansion deals are driving a lot of the growth, but procurement timelines are still long for enterprises.
[01:10] Maya Patel: great, on the macro - hiring's healthy, burn's within plan, invest in reliability and product-market fit. Priorities today: share the product roadmap, the infra post-mortem, and people org updates.
[01:26] Sophie Tran: headcount - we closed 8 roles this quarter, ramping for four more, hiring bar remains high, also update on parental leave policy rollout.
[01:36] Zara Khan: customer success highlights - three pilots moved to production this month, CSAT trending +0.12, but we're seeing two recurring issues with token billing granularity.
[01:50] Marcus Lee: infra post-mortem - P1 last Tuesday due to autoscaling misconfiguration on Dedicated pools; root cause was a scheduling window with our cluster autoscaler and legacy gating flag.
[02:05] Owen Park: yeah, essentially the autoscaler didn't account for continuous-batching load, so the headroom estimate was off, we hit backpressure and then the fallback to the hosted variant wasn't seamless for one customer.
[02:18] Marcus Lee: action: adjust autoscale thresholds, rollout a canary for the new scaler, and improve our metrics dashboard for per-pool queue length.
[02:29] Priya Nair: product implications - we need a migration doc that sets expectations for latency vs cost tradeoffs, and a new routing policy knob for customers to prefer latency or cost.
[02:41] Jun Kim: devrel will produce the migration samples, including a terraform example and a quickstart for private.
[02:48] Lena Rodriguez: on GTM, customers keep asking about SOC2 and audit logs - can we surface the compliance package more prominently? I'm getting it in three RFPs this week.
[02:58] Maya Patel: yes, security & compliance is table stakes, Priya can coordinate with ops to create a one-pager.
[03:04] Priya Nair: noted.
[03:07] Ethan Shaw: pipeline notes - longer procurement cycles but higher ACV, competitive mentions: OtherCloudAI and BigModelInc, some customers picking Redwood for unified infra.
[03:20] Marcus Lee: performance update - 95th percentile latency on hosted improved 12% after kernel selection tuning; but Dedicated tail latency needs work under burst events.
[03:33] Owen Park: kernel tuning is good, but we also need smarter KV cache TTL heuristics for streaming workloads to avoid cache churn.
[03:44] Marcus Lee: we have some quantization candidates that cut GPU memory by 40% without a material quality drop on our eval suite; want to pilot with two customers.
[03:58] Priya Nair: piloting quantization is product priority, but we need to tie it to quality regression checks. We'll run evals and hold regression alerts.
[04:10] Jun Kim: we'll build a sample evaluation harness and include it in devkit.
[04:18] Sophie Tran: people update - new compensation cycle timeline, managers please complete calibration by 2026-04-12. Also note all-hands survey going out after this meeting.
[04:31] Maya Patel: a couple of kudos - infra team for the P1 response and DevRel for onboarding content last month, appreciated.
[04:41] Q&A open
[04:42] (Employee question) Speaker 12: what's the timeline for Private GA?
[04:47] Priya Nair: target for broader GA is late Q2, but limited early access customers will start in mid-April. We'll refine based on pilot feedback.
[04:56] (Employee) Speaker 8: any changes to remote-work policy?
[04:59] Sophie Tran: no major changes, we are updating office stipends and travel allowances, details in an email by end of week.
[05:07] (Employee) Speaker 15: can we get more transparency on customer escalations?
[05:10] Zara Khan: yes, we'll publish a quarterly support trends dashboard, first iteration by 2026-04-02.
[05:18] Maya Patel: quick note on finances - runway extended with Series C, prioritizing product and sales investments, being mindful of burn.
[05:29] Ethan Shaw: customer references - we have three referenceable customers willing to speak, I'll coordinate.
[05:36] Marcus Lee: ops follow-up - we'll be changing default autoscale thresholds and shipping a canary next week, expect minor rollout risk.
[05:47] Priya Nair: product follow-up - roadmap deck will be shared next week, including the Dedicated scaling plan and the Optimize toolkit features.
[05:58] Maya Patel: wrap up - thanks all, action items are in the chat and will be added to Asana, please review and comment.
[06:08] Meeting end.
